Maharashtra on 20 January, 2023

Author: M. S. Karnik
Bench: M. S. Karnik
 Darshan Patil 908-aba-183-23.doc
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 183 Of 2023
 Soniya Raja @ Rajesh Chhabria and Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent
 ------------
 Ganesh Gole i/b Arif Ali N. Ali and Bittu Dadlani for the
 Applicant.
Ms. A. A. Takalkar, App for the State.
Psi Manish N. Waghmare, Central Police Station.

------------
 Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
Date : January 20, 2023 P.C. :
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State.

2. This is an application of pre-arrest bail in respect of the offence punishable under sections 498A, 406, 341, 504, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in connection with C.R. No.0178 of 2022 registered with Thane Central Police Station.
3. The complainant is the wife of the deceased - Rahul Verma.

It is alleged that after the death of the deceased when the complainant went to her matrimonial home she Darshan Patil 908-aba-183-23.doc was obstructed by the applicants and all her jewellery and car is found misappropriated by the applicants.

Learned APP submits that dispite issuance of the notice under section 41A the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, applicants have not attended the Investigating Officer.
4. Let the applicant nos. 3 and 4 to attend the Investigating Officer on 23/01/2023 and 24/01/2023 between 11.00 am and 1.00 pm.
